image_description: A group of people, mostly young women and girls, are dancing around a tall wooden maypole in a grassy park setting. The pole is decorated with long, colorful ribbons (red, blue, yellow, white) that extend from the top to the dancers' hands. The top of the pole features a decorative wreath or floral arrangement. Trees and houses are visible in the background.
